In November of that month we spoke first of the "keystone xl pipeline." Eighty-four of us said it on 2015-11-06, and eighty-two said "the keystone xl," and eighty said "the keystone xl pipeline." John Hoeven had said it first, on 2013-01-22, and by that day most of us were saying it together.

Then on 2015-11-19 sixty-nine of us said "security against foreign enemies," and sixty-eight said "american security against foreign enemies," and sixty-four said "the american security against foreign enemies." Fifty-seven of us reached the full "security against foreign enemies safe act." That phrase had first appeared two days before, on 2015-11-17. Sixty-three of us said "of homeland security."

We converged twice in one month, on a pipeline and on a bill, and the record shows how many of us said each.
